author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Why are people so obsessed with setting up a 2nd brian when their 1st brian can't even think clearly? 

Don't waste your time setting up 2nd brian, just have a habit of writing down your thoughts as blog posts instead.  You don't need a fancy database to search your own writing.  WordPress search is more than enough.
